title: Recovery: Important Systems
summary: Read the Recovery signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Grave snapshots, compass target data, dimension behavior, expiration rules, and contamination notes can all change the best retrieval plan.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch compass targets, grave location, timer pressure if present, spare gear quality, route hazards, and whether you are about to repeat the same mistake.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Recovery system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
